scientific_question: At the same 60-second per-pair wall-clock cap, how do ENPDA-Solver and RASCAL compare on the complete sanitized native scope?

enpda.stream_order: cyclically rotated by the preregistered search seed
enpda.allocation: remaining wall time is divided equally among the remaining streams
enpda.candidate_admission: only a legal candidate completed no later than the global 60-second deadline may update the returned incumbent

rascal.timeout_policy: retain and score the legal incumbent on every timeout
